headline: Clinton order closed federal government offices on Friday, December 26, 1997, the day after Christmas.
what_it_does: This executive order closed federal executive departments and agencies on Friday, December 26, 1997. That gave most federal workers a day off right after the Christmas holiday, creating a four-day weekend. Orders like this usually let agency heads keep some offices open if needed for national security or other public needs.

who_it_affects.how: Most federal workers got Friday, December 26, 1997, off from work.

who_it_affects.group: People who use federal offices and services
who_it_affects.how: Federal offices were closed that day, so in-person services were likely unavailable.
